item.title: Bulletin updated at 13:20 HKT 28/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A southerly airstream will affect the region gradually in the following few days. Besides, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over southern China over the weekend and early next week. With the upper-air disturbances departing slightly, the weather will improve over the coastal areas of Guangdong midweek next week.
